# infisical_pam_account_template (Resource)

Create and manage account templates in Infisical PAM. A template holds the account type, gateway, policies and settings shared by its accounts. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

data "infisical_gateway" "main" {
  name = "prod-gateway"
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_template" "ssh" {
  name         = "ssh-default"
  description  = "Standard SSH access"
  account_type = "ssh"
  gateway_id   = data.infisical_gateway.main.id

  policies = {
    requires_approval    = true
    allow_break_glass    = true
    require_reason       = true
    max_session_duration = 3600
    command_blocking     = ["^rm -rf /", "^shutdown"]
  }

  settings = {
    recording = {
      storage_backend = "aws-s3"
      connection_id   = "<aws-app-connection-id>"
      s3 = {
        bucket     = "acme-pam-recordings"
        region     = "us-east-1"
        key_prefix = "ssh/"
      }
    }

    session_log_masking = {
      patterns           = ["password=\\S+"]
      built_in_detection = true
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_template" "postgres" {
  name         = "postgres-rotated"
  account_type = "postgres"
  gateway_id   = data.infisical_gateway.main.id

  settings = {
    rotation = {
      enabled          = true
      interval_seconds = 604800
    }

    password_requirements = {
      length = 32
      required = {
        digits    = 2
        lowercase = 2
        uppercase = 2
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_type` (String) The type of account the template applies to. Changing it creates a new template. Options: ssh, postgres, mysql, mssql, oracledb, mongodb, redis, snowflake, clickhouse, kubernetes, aws-iam, gcp-service-account, azure-cli, windows, windows-ad.
- `name` (String) The name of the account template, unique in the organization. Must be lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, at most 64 characters.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the account template.
- `gateway_id` (String) The ID of the gateway that accounts using the template connect through, unless an account sets its own.
- `gateway_pool_id` (String) The ID of the gateway pool that accounts using the template connect through, unless an account sets its own.
- `policies` (Attributes) Access policies applied to every account using the template. A policy left unset is off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))
- `settings` (Attributes) Session recording, log masking, health check and rotation settings. Unset values take their defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the account template.

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Optional:

- `allow_auto_approval` (Boolean) Whether requests that pass one of the folder's auto-approval rules are approved instantly. Has no effect unless `requires_approval` is true.
- `allow_break_glass` (Boolean) Whether the folder's break-glass users can grant themselves access in an emergency. Has no effect unless `requires_approval` is true.
- `command_blocking` (List of String) Regular expressions, one per command or statement to reject during a session. Only for `ssh`, `snowflake`, `clickhouse` templates.
- `max_session_duration` (Number) The maximum session length in seconds, from 60 to 86400 (900 to 3600 for `aws-iam` templates).
- `require_mfa` (Boolean) Whether users must re-authenticate with MFA before accessing an account.
- `require_reason` (Boolean) Whether users must give a reason before accessing an account.
- `requires_approval` (Boolean) Whether users must request and receive approval before launching a session or viewing credentials.


<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Optional:

- `heartbeat` (Attributes) Scheduled checks that each account's stored credential still works. Defaults to a daily check. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--heartbeat))
- `password_requirements` (Attributes) Requirements for the passwords rotation generates and for passwords set on accounts. Only for `postgres`, `mysql`, `mssql`, `oracledb`, `windows`, `windows-ad` templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--password_requirements))
- `recording` (Attributes) Session recording. Defaults to recording every session into Infisical's database. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--recording))
- `rotation` (Attributes) Scheduled credential rotation. Only for `postgres`, `mysql`, `mssql`, `oracledb`, `windows`, `windows-ad` templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--rotation))
- `session_log_masking` (Attributes) Masking of sensitive values in session logs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--session_log_masking))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--heartbeat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.heartbeat`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether credential health checking is on. Set `interval_seconds` as well to run it on a schedule.

Optional:

- `interval_seconds` (Number) How often credential health checking runs, in seconds, from 3600 to 31536000. Leave unset to run it only on demand.


<a id="nestedatt--settings--password_requirements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.password_requirements`

Required:

- `length` (Number) The length of the password, from 1 to 250 (at most 30 for `oracledb` templates).
- `required` (Attributes) The minimum number of each kind of character. At least one must be above 0, and together they can't exceed `length`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--password_requirements--required))

Optional:

- `allowed_symbols` (String) The symbols the password may contain, drawn from `!@#$%^&*()-_=+[]{}|:,.<>/~`.

<a id="nestedatt--settings--password_requirements--required"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.password_requirements.required`

Optional:

- `digits` (Number) The minimum number of digits in the password. Defaults to 0.
- `lowercase` (Number) The minimum number of lowercase letters in the password. Defaults to 0.
- `symbols` (Number) The minimum number of symbols in the password. Defaults to 0.
- `uppercase` (Number) The minimum number of uppercase letters in the password. Defaults to 0.



<a id="nestedatt--settings--recording"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.recording`

Optional:

- `connection_id` (String) The ID of the AWS or S3-Compatible Storage app connection used to store recordings.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether sessions are recorded. Defaults to true.
- `s3` (Attributes) The bucket recordings are stored in when `storage_backend` is `aws-s3`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--recording--s3))
- `storage_backend` (String) Where recordings are stored: `postgres` (Infisical's database) or `aws-s3`, which needs `connection_id` and `s3`. Defaults to `postgres`.

<a id="nestedatt--settings--recording--s3"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.recording.s3`

Required:

- `bucket` (String) The name of the bucket.

Optional:

- `key_prefix` (String) An optional prefix for the recording object keys.
- `region` (String) The AWS region of the bucket. Leave unset for S3-Compatible Storage connections.



<a id="nestedatt--settings--rotation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.rotation`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether credential rotation is on. Set `interval_seconds` as well to run it on a schedule.

Optional:

- `interval_seconds` (Number) How often credential rotation runs, in seconds, from 3600 to 31536000. Leave unset to run it only on demand.


<a id="nestedatt--settings--session_log_masking"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.session_log_masking`

Optional:

- `built_in_detection` (Boolean) Whether common secrets are masked without a pattern. Defaults to true, except for `windows`, `windows-ad` and `aws-iam` templates.
- `patterns` (List of String) Regular expressions whose matches are masked in session logs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the PAM account template by its ID
terraform import infisical_pam_account_template.example <template_id>
```
